## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Graz, Austria. It starts at Lendkai 1.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> No it's not a spaceship, it's the oddly shaped and eye-catching Kunsthaus Graz! As part of the huge Universalmuseum Joanneum, this joint venture from the Province of Styria and the City of Graz is dedicated to permanent and changing, vibrant contemporary art exhibitions.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €14.62. It was rated 4.2 out of 5 from 28 ratings and 16 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
